company_information.value: API docs your agent writes and every agent can use
DocStar is an API documentation platform for people and AI agents. It turns your code into API docs, llms.txt, a hosted MCP server and a CLI, and keeps them in sync.

DocStar is an API documentation platform for people and AI agents. A user pastes one setup prompt into a coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. The agent reads the API's routes and creates the docs, so no OpenAPI file is needed. Users who already have an OpenAPI, Swagger 2 or Postman file can import it instead.

From the same source, DocStar publishes a docs site with a try-it playground, llms.txt and markdown for every page, a hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in, a CLI (docstar-cli), and an OpenAPI 3 export. Agents create drafts and propose changes. The user reviews and publishes, unless they turn on auto-publish for a project.

After launch, DocStar watches the repo through a GitHub app or GitHub Actions sync and drafts doc fixes when routes, params or responses change. It also offers analytics on human and agent traffic, and white-label options for domain, MCP server, CLI name and look. For developers who use APIs, installing the DocStar MCP once lets their agent find, read and call APIs documented on DocStar.

Agent-written API docs: the coding agent reads your routes and creates every endpoint with auth, params, bodies and responses
Import OpenAPI 3, Swagger 2 or Postman collections
Docs site with a try-it playground, code samples, environments, guides, changelogs, search and AI answers
llms.txt, llms-full.txt and a markdown twin for every page
Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in and search, read (get docs) and call tools, plus optional custom tools for key endpoints
docstar-cli: every published endpoint becomes a terminal command, and the CLI can run as a local MCP server over stdio
OpenAPI 3 export at any time, with no lock-in
Drift detection through a GitHub app and GitHub Actions sync, with fixes drafted for approval
Agents using the MCP server report missing or wrong docs
Agent analytics split by channel: top questions, failed searches, popular endpoints and client names
White-label: custom domain, subdomain or sub-path, branded MCP server and CLI, logo, colours, fonts, and removable Built with DocStar badge
Copy prompt button and one-click MCP install for Cursor, VS Code and Claude on every docs page
Redirect management, published version history, real-time collaborative editing and full-text search (listed on the pricing page)
Teams that publish APIs and want docs, an MCP server and a CLI for people and AI agents, and developers who want their coding agents to find, read and call APIs documented on DocStar.
API documentation, MCP server, llms.txt, CLI generator, OpenAPI, AI agents, white-label docs, Claude Code, Cursor, docs sync

Free plan: unlimited pages and the full API docs workspace at no cost under a fair-usage policy, including custom domain, OpenAPI/Swagger/Postman import, OpenAPI export and 1 member. Pro: $25 per month, includes 10 members, with teammates added for $5/user. Enterprise: custom pricing, adds unlimited members and collections, a dedicated success manager and priority support.
